calls.video_title: Interesting News for eBay Stock Investors
calls.thesis: HOLD, first tracked for Parkevtate (no prior EBAY call in calls.json, so no formal tracked flip) — he says he is downgrading eBay from a buying opportunity (last updated 24 Aug 2026) to a hold, medium conviction, after a >41% YTD run plus dividends made it slightly overvalued: forward P/E 18.4, highest in a couple of years, vs his $110 DCF at a $123 price. News in the video: eBay announced a 9% headcount cut (second round this year, after 6% earlier), to streamline and prioritise its best units.
